Young people's immune system seems to be very capable of defeating this virus. Hands should be washed as frequently as you can because this virus can survive. We don't know exactly how long, but it can survive at least briefly on hard surfaces. You know, we go through life touching doorknobs and elevator buttons and seatbelts and all kinds of things. It just makes sense to wash hands.
